integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from the classical Euler-trail criterion; finite literal and graph-profile checks are reproducible in verify.py and do not serve as an infinite proof.
limitations: Only complete unordered overlapping length-two factor composition multisets on a four-letter labeled alphabet, for linear words of length at least two.
Does not determine class multiplicities, error correction, incomplete readout, or cyclic words.
An earlier unindexed multigraph-counting specialization may cover the enumeration.
title: Exact quaternary unordered-bigram spectra and the first Euler-parity obstruction
